title: upgrade: main and a branch upgraded apart conflict on work-package records at merge
body:
Reported from an attendee's first `intent upgrade` to 3.5.1 in a practice repo with open branches (hv's AE decision 165, 2026-11-23, relayed by agentic-engineering-vc and devbin-vc). These are the attendee's steps and AE has not reproduced them.

`main` and a branch were each upgraded on their own. The merge then gave add/add conflicts on four work-package records: one was WIP on `main` and done on the branch. A branch that merged `main` before its own upgrade merged cleanly.

Questions for the fix:
- Can the records an upgrade writes merge cleanly when two branches upgrade apart, eg as the same bytes for the same state?
- If not, should the upgrade notes, and upgrade's own output on a repo with other branches, say to merge `main` into each branch before upgrading it?
